verses.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־ תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem ’ĕ·lî·lim ū·p̄e·sel ū·maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh lō- ṯā·qî·mū lā·ḵem wə·’e·ḇen maś·kîṯ lō ṯit·tə·nū bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ ‘ā·le·hā kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar you must not place a sculpted . . . stone in your land to bow down to it For I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: NÃO fareis para vós ídolos, nem vos levantareis imagem de escultura, nem estátua, nem poreis pedra figurada na vossa terra, para inclinar-vos a ela; porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay tiš·mō·rū ū·miq·dā·šî tî·rā·’ū ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Guardareis os meus sábados, e reverenciareis o meu santuário. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: אִם־ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־ מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- bə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay tê·lê·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miṣ·wō·ṯay tiš·mə·rū wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep . . . My commandments
verses.literalPt: Se andardes nos meus estatutos, e guardardes os meus mandamentos, e os cumprirdes,

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḡiš·mê·ḵem bə·‘it·tām wə·nā·ṯə·nāh hā·’ā·reṣ yə·ḇū·lāh wə·‘êṣ haś·śā·ḏeh yit·tên pir·yōw
verses.literal: I will give you rains in their season and the land will yield its produce and the trees of the field will bear their fruit
verses.literalPt: Então eu vos darei as chuvas a seu tempo; e a terra dará a sua colheita, e a árvore do campo dará o seu fruto;

verses.original: וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֙יִשׁ֙ אֶת־ בָּצִ֔יר וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־ זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiś·śîḡ lā·ḵem da·yiš ’eṯ- bā·ṣîr ū·ḇā·ṣîr yaś·śîḡ ’eṯ- zā·ra‘ wa·’ă·ḵal·tem laḥ·mə·ḵem lā·śō·ḇa‘ wî·šaḇ·tem lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem
verses.literal: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land
verses.literalPt: E a debulha se vos chegará à vindima, e a vindima se chegará à sementeira; e comereis o vosso pão a fartar, e habitareis seguros na vossa terra.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־ תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî šā·lō·wm bā·’ā·reṣ ū·šə·ḵaḇ·tem wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ wə·hiš·bat·tî ḥay·yāh rā·‘āh min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḥe·reḇ lō- ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem
verses.literal: And I will give peace to the land and you will lie down with nothing to fear I will rid the land of dangerous animals and no sword will pass through your land
verses.literalPt: Também darei paz na terra, e dormireis seguros, e não haverá quem vos espante; e farei cessar os animais nocivos da terra, e pela vossa terra não passará espada.

verses.original: וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָפְל֥וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·ḏap̄·tem ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem wə·nā·p̄ə·lū lip̄·nê·ḵem lɛ·ḥå̄·rɛḇ
verses.literal: You will pursue your enemies and they will fall by the sword before you
verses.literalPt: E perseguireis os vossos inimigos, e cairão à espada diante de vós.

verses.original: וְרָדְפ֨וּ מִכֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּמֵאָ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְנָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם לֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḏə·p̄ū mik·kem ḥă·miš·šāh mê·’āh ū·mê·’āh mik·kem rə·ḇā·ḇāh yir·dō·p̄ū wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem lip̄·nê·ḵem le·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Five of you will pursue a hundred and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand and your enemies will fall by the sword before you
verses.literalPt: Cinco de vós perseguirão a um cento deles, e cem de vós perseguirão a dez mil; e os vossos inimigos cairão à espada diante de vós.

verses.original: וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯî ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·hip̄·rê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem wa·hă·qî·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you and I will establish My covenant with you
verses.literalPt: E para vós olharei, e vos farei frutificar, e vos multiplicarei, e confirmarei a minha aliança convosco.

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḵal·tem yā·šān nō·wō·šān wə·yā·šān mip·pə·nê ḥā·ḏāš tō·w·ṣî·’ū
verses.literal: You will still be eating the old supply of grain . . . when you need to clear it out to make room for the new
verses.literalPt: E comereis da colheita velha, há muito tempo guardada, e tirareis fora a velha por causa da nova.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî miš·kā·nî bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·lō- ṯiḡ·‘al nap̄·šî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: And I will make My dwelling place among you and My soul will not despise you
verses.literalPt: E porei o meu tabernáculo no meio de vós, e a minha alma de vós não se enfadará.

verses.original: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָכֶ֖ם לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ־ לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·hā·yî·ṯî lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm wə·’at·tem tih·yū- lî lə·‘ām
verses.literal: I will walk among you and be your God and you will be My people
verses.literalPt: E andarei no meio de vós, e eu vos serei por Deus, e vós me sereis por povo.

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mih·yōṯ lā·hem ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wā·’eš·bōr mō·ṭōṯ ‘ul·lə·ḵem wā·’ō·w·lêḵ ’eṯ·ḵem qō·wm·mî·yūṯ
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra dos egípcios, para que não fôsseis seus escravos; e quebrei os timões do vosso jugo, e vos fiz andar eretos.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū lî wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ’êṯ kāl- ham·miṣ·wōṯ hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: If, however you fail to obey Me . . . and to carry out all these commandments
verses.literalPt: Mas, se não me ouvirdes, e não cumprirdes todos estes mandamentos,

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְאִ֥ם אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֔י לְהַפְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay tim·’ā·sū wə·’im ’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay tiḡ·‘al nap̄·šə·ḵem lə·ḇil·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯay lə·hap̄·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: and if you reject . . . My statutes despise . . . My ordinances and neglect to carry out all My commandments and so break My covenant
verses.literalPt: E se rejeitardes os meus estatutos, e a vossa alma se enfadar dos meus juízos, não cumprindo todos os meus mandamentos, para invalidar a minha aliança,

verses.original: אַף־ אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ זֹּ֣את לָכֶ֗ם וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְאֶת־ הַקַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּמְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָרִיק֙ זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- zōṯ lā·ḵem wə·hip̄·qaḏ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem be·hā·lāh ’eṯ- haš·ša·ḥe·p̄eṯ wə·’eṯ- haq·qad·da·ḥaṯ mə·ḵal·lō·wṯ ‘ê·na·yim ū·mə·ḏî·ḇōṯ nā·p̄eš ū·zə·ra‘·tem lā·rîq zar·‘ă·ḵem wa·’ă·ḵā·lu·hū ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: then this is what I will do to you I will bring upon you sudden terror wasting disease and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life You will sow your seed in vain because your enemies will eat it
verses.literalPt: Então eu também vos farei isto: porei sobre vós terror, a tísica e a febre ardente, que consumam os olhos e atormentem a alma; e semeareis em vão a vossa semente, pois os vossos inimigos a comerão.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י פָנַי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְנִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־ רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî p̄ā·nay bā·ḵem wə·nig·gap̄·tem lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem wə·rā·ḏū ḇā·ḵem śō·nə·’ê·ḵem wə·nas·tem wə·’ên- rō·ḏêp̄ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: And I will set My face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies Those who hate you will rule over you and you will flee when no one pursues you
verses.literalPt: E porei a minha face contra vós, e sereis feridos diante de vossos inimigos; e os que vos odeiam, de vós se assenhorearão, e fugireis, sem ninguém vos perseguir.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־ עַד־ אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּי֙ לְיַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ‘aḏ- ’êl·leh lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū lî wə·yā·sap̄·tî lə·yas·sə·rāh ’eṯ·ḵem še·ḇa‘ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: And if after all this you will not obey Me I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins
verses.literalPt: E, se ainda com estas coisas não me ouvirdes, então eu prosseguirei a castigar-vos sete vezes mais, por causa dos vossos pecados.

verses.original: וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּכֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ שְׁמֵיכֶם֙ כַּבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶֽת־ אַרְצְכֶ֖ם כַּנְּחֻשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- gə·’ō·wn ‘uz·zə·ḵem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- šə·mê·ḵem kab·bar·zel wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣə·ḵem kan·nə·ḥu·šāh
verses.literal: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze
verses.literalPt: Porque quebrarei a soberba da vossa força; e farei que os vossos céus sejam como ferro e a vossa terra como cobre.

verses.original: וְתַ֥ם לָרִ֖יק כֹּחֲכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְכֶם֙ אֶת־ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְעֵ֣ץ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯam lā·rîq kō·ḥă·ḵem wə·lō- ṯit·tên ’ar·ṣə·ḵem ’eṯ- yə·ḇū·lāh wə·‘êṣ hā·’ā·reṣ lō yit·tên pir·yōw
verses.literal: and your strength will be spent in vain For your land will not yield its produce and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit
verses.literalPt: E em vão se gastará a vossa força; a vossa terra não dará a sua colheita, e as árvores da terra não darão o seu fruto.

verses.original: וְאִם־ תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּי֙ קֶ֔רִי וְלֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑י וְיָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tê·lə·ḵū ‘im·mî qe·rî wə·lō ṯō·ḇū liš·mō·a‘ lî wə·yā·sap̄·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem mak·kāh še·ḇa‘ kə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse . . . to obey Me I will multiply . . . your plagues seven times according to your sins
verses.literalPt: E se andardes contrariamente para comigo, e não me quiserdes ouvir, trar-vos-ei pragas sete vezes mais, conforme os vossos pecados.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְשִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהִכְרִ֙יתָה֙ אֶת־ בְּהֶמְתְּכֶ֔ם וְהִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·laḥ·tî ḇā·ḵem ’eṯ- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·šik·kə·lāh ’eṯ·ḵem wə·hiḵ·rî·ṯāh ’eṯ- bə·hem·tə·ḵem wə·him·‘î·ṭāh ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nā·šam·mū dar·ḵê·ḵem
verses.literal: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children destroy your livestock and reduce your numbers until your roads lie desolate
verses.literalPt: Porque enviarei entre vós as feras do campo, as quais vos desfilharão, e desfarão o vosso gado, e vos diminuirão; e os vossos caminhos serão desertos.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־ בְּאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י קֶֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·’êl·leh lō ṯiw·wā·sə·rū lî wa·hă·laḵ·tem ‘im·mî qe·rî
verses.literal: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline . . . but continue to walk in hostility toward Me
verses.literalPt: Se ainda com estas coisas não vos corrigirdes voltando para mim, mas ainda andardes contrariamente para comigo,

verses.original: וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף־ אֲנִ֛י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֑רִי וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ גַּם־ אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·laḵ·tî ’ap̄- ’ă·nî ‘im·mā·ḵem bə·qe·rî wə·hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem gam- ’ā·nî še·ḇa‘ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: then I will act . . . with hostility toward you and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins
verses.literalPt: Eu também andarei contrariamente para convosco, e eu, eu mesmo, vos ferirei sete vezes mais por causa dos vossos pecados.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֙מֶת֙ נְקַם־ בְּרִ֔ית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל־ עָרֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֙בֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹכְכֶ֔ם וְנִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ḥe·reḇ nō·qe·meṯ nə·qam- bə·rîṯ wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄·tem ’el- ‘ā·rê·ḵem wə·šil·laḥ·tî ḏe·ḇer bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·nit·tat·tem bə·yaḏ- ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant Though you withdraw into your cities I will send a plague among you and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy
verses.literalPt: Porque trarei sobre vós a espada, que executará a vingança da aliança; e ajuntados sereis nas vossas cidades; então enviarei a peste entre vós, e sereis entregues na mão do inimigo.

verses.original: בְּשִׁבְרִ֣י לָכֶם֮ מַטֵּה־ לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְכֶם֙ בְּתַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְהֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְכֶ֖ם בַּמִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·šiḇ·rî lā·ḵem maṭ·ṭêh- le·ḥem wə·’ā·p̄ū ‘e·śer nā·šîm laḥ·mə·ḵem bə·ṯan·nūr ’e·ḥāḏ wə·hê·šî·ḇū laḥ·mə·ḵem bam·miš·qāl wa·’ă·ḵal·tem wə·lō ṯiś·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: When I cut off your supply of bread ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight so that you will eat but not be satisfied
verses.literalPt: Quando eu vos quebrar o sustento do pão, então dez mulheres cozerão o vosso pão num só forno, e devolver-vos-ão o vosso pão por peso; e comereis, mas não vos fartareis.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם־ בְּזֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑י וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·zōṯ lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū lî wa·hă·laḵ·tem ‘im·mî bə·qe·rî
verses.literal: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me but continue to walk in hostility toward Me
verses.literalPt: E se com isto não me ouvirdes, mas ainda andardes contrariamente para comigo,

verses.original: וְהָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּכֶ֖ם בַּחֲמַת־ קֶ֑רִי וְיִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ אַף־ אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל־ חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·laḵ·tî ‘im·mā·ḵem ba·ḥă·maṯ- qe·rî wə·yis·sar·tî ’eṯ·ḵem ’ap̄- ’ā·nî še·ḇa‘ ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯē·ḵɛm
verses.literal: then I will walk in fury against you and I even I will punish you sevenfold for your sins
verses.literalPt: Também eu para convosco andarei contrariamente em furor; e vos castigarei sete vezes mais por causa dos vossos pecados.

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וּבְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḵal·tem bə·śar bə·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·śar bə·nō·ṯê·ḵem tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Porque comereis a carne de vossos filhos, e a carne de vossas filhas.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת־ בָּמֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת־ חַמָּ֣נֵיכֶ֔ם וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ פִּגְרֵיכֶ֔ם עַל־ פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וְגָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·maḏ·tî ’eṯ- bā·mō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’eṯ- ḥam·mā·nê·ḵem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- piḡ·rê·ḵem ‘al- piḡ·rê gil·lū·lê·ḵem wə·ḡā·‘ă·lāh nap̄·šî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: I will destroy your high places cut down your incense altars and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols and My soul will despise you
verses.literalPt: E destruirei os vossos altos, e desfarei as vossas imagens, e lançarei os vossos cadáveres sobre os cadáveres dos vossos deuses; a minha alma se enfadará de vós.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ עָֽרֵיכֶם֙ חָרְבָּ֔ה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּרֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ‘ā·rê·ḵem ḥā·rə·bāh wa·hă·šim·mō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- miq·də·šê·ḵem wə·lō ’ā·rî·aḥ bə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·ḥă·ḵem
verses.literal: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices
verses.literalPt: E reduzirei as vossas cidades a deserto, e assolarei os vossos santuários, e não cheirarei o vosso cheiro suave.

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵיכֶ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·šim·mō·ṯî ’ă·nî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šā·mə·mū ‘ā·le·hā ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bāh
verses.literal: And I will lay waste the land so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled . . .
verses.literalPt: E assolarei a terra e se espantarão disso os vossos inimigos que nela morarem.

verses.original: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְהָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְכֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְעָרֵיכֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חָרְבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ·ḵem ’ĕ·zā·reh ḇag·gō·w·yim wa·hă·rî·qō·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵem ḥā·reḇ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’ar·ṣə·ḵem šə·mā·māh wə·‘ā·rê·ḵem yih·yū ḥā·rə·bāh
verses.literal: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste
verses.literalPt: E espalhar-vos-ei entre as nações, e desembainharei a espada atrás de vós; e a vossa terra será assolada, e as vossas cidades serão desertas.

verses.original: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הֳשַׁמָּ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִרְצָ֖ת אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tir·ṣeh hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯe·hā kōl yə·mê hoš·šam·māh wə·’at·tem bə·’e·reṣ ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem ’āz tiš·baṯ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hir·ṣāṯ ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate while you are in the land of your enemies At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths
verses.literalPt: Então a terra folgará nos seus sábados, todos os dias da sua assolação, e vós estareis na terra dos vossos inimigos; então a terra descansará, e folgará nos seus sábados.

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י הָשַּׁמָּ֖ה תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶ֥ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê hāš·šam·māh tiš·bōṯ ’êṯ ’ă·šer lō- šā·ḇə·ṯāh bə·šab·bə·ṯō·ṯê·ḵem bə·šiḇ·tə·ḵem ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: As long as . . . it lies desolate the land will have the rest - it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it
verses.literalPt: Todos os dias da assolação descansará, porque não descansou nos vossos sábados, quando habitáveis nela.

verses.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֙רֶךְ֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְרָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְנָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת־ חֶ֛רֶב וְנָפְל֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·ḵem wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî mō·reḵ bil·ḇā·ḇām bə·’ar·ṣōṯ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem wə·rā·ḏap̄ ’ō·ṯām qō·wl ‘ā·leh nid·dāp̄ wə·nā·sū mə·nu·saṯ- ḥe·reḇ wə·nā·p̄ə·lū wə·’ên rō·ḏêp̄
verses.literal: As for those of you who survive . . . I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight And they will flee as one flees the sword and fall when no one pursues them
verses.literalPt: E, quanto aos que de vós ficarem, eu porei tal pavor nos seus corações, nas terras dos seus inimigos, que o ruído de uma folha movida os perseguirá; e fugirão como quem foge da espada; e cairão sem ninguém os perseguir.

verses.original: וְכָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ־ בְּאָחִ֛יו כְּמִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב וְרֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְלֹא־ תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·šə·lū ’îš- bə·’ā·ḥîw kə·mip·pə·nê- ḥe·reḇ wə·rō·ḏêp̄ ’ā·yin wə·lō- ṯih·yeh lā·ḵem tə·qū·māh lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: They will stumble over one another as before the sword though no one is behind them So you will not be able to stand against your enemies
verses.literalPt: E cairão uns sobre os outros como diante da espada, sem ninguém os perseguir; e não podereis resistir diante dos vossos inimigos.

verses.original: וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְאָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḇaḏ·tem bag·gō·w·yim wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’eṯ·ḵem ’e·reṣ ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: You will perish among the nations and the land of your enemies will consume you
verses.literalPt: E perecereis entre as nações, e a terra dos vossos inimigos vos consumirá.

verses.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּכֶ֗ם יִמַּ֙קּוּ֙ בַּֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם בְּאַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַ֛ף בַּעֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖ם אִתָּ֥ם יִמָּֽקּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·niš·’ā·rîm bā·ḵem yim·maq·qū ba·‘ă·wō·nām bə·’ar·ṣōṯ ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem wə·’ap̄ ba·‘ă·wō·nōṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām ’it·tām yim·māq·qū
verses.literal: Those of you who survive . . . in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers . . .
verses.literalPt: E aqueles que entre vós ficarem se consumirão pela sua iniqüidade nas terras dos vossos inimigos, e pela iniqüidade de seus pais com eles se consumirão.

verses.original: וְהִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָם֙ וְאֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בִ֑י וְאַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר־ הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖י בְּקֶֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·wad·dū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nām wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḇō·ṯām bə·ma·‘ă·lām ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū- ḇî wə·’ap̄ ’ă·šer- hā·lə·ḵū ‘im·mî bə·qe·rî
verses.literal: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me
verses.literalPt: Então confessarão a sua iniqüidade, e a iniqüidade de seus pais, com as suas transgressões, com que transgrediram contra mim; como também eles andaram contrariamente para comigo.

verses.original: אַף־ אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּם֙ בְּקֶ֔רִי וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם אוֹ־ אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָם֙ הֶֽעָרֵ֔ל וְאָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’ă·nî ’ê·lêḵ ‘im·mām bə·qe·rî wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’ō·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem ’ōw- ’āz yik·kā·na‘ lə·ḇā·ḇām he·‘ā·rêl wə·’āz yir·ṣū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies and . . . if their uncircumcised . . . hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity
verses.literalPt: Eu também andei para com eles contrariamente, e os fiz entrar na terra dos seus inimigos; se então o seu coração incircunciso se humilhar, e então tomarem por bem o castigo da sua iniqüidade,

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֣י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ wə·’ap̄ ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî yiṣ·ḥāq wə·’ap̄ ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ez·kōr wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ’ez·kōr
verses.literal: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and - My covenant with Isaac . . . and My covenant with Abraham and I will remember the land
verses.literalPt: Também eu me lembrarei da minha aliança com Jacó, e também da minha aliança com Isaque, e também da minha aliança com Abraão me lembrarei, e da terra me lembrarei.

verses.original: וְהָאָרֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵהֶ֜ם וְתִ֣רֶץ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗יהָ בָּהְשַׁמָּה֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְהֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת־ עֲוֺנָ֑ם יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֔עַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י מָאָ֔סוּ וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֖י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tê·‘ā·zêḇ mê·hem wə·ṯi·reṣ ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯe·hā bā·hə·šam·māh mê·hem wə·hêm yir·ṣū ’eṯ- ‘ă·wō·nām ya·‘an ū·ḇə·ya·‘an bə·miš·pā·ṭay mā·’ā·sū wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay gā·‘ă·lāh nap̄·šām
verses.literal: For the land will be abandoned by them and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity because . . . they rejected My ordinances and abhorred . . . My statutes
verses.literalPt: E a terra será abandonada por eles, e folgará nos seus sábados, sendo assolada por causa deles; e tomarão por bem o castigo da sua iniqüidade, em razão mesmo de que rejeitaram os meus juízos e a sua alma se enfastiou dos meus estatutos.

verses.original: וְאַף־ גַּם־ זֹ֠את בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֞ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֗ם לֹֽא־ מְאַסְתִּ֤ים וְלֹֽא־ גְעַלְתִּים֙ לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄- gam- zōṯ bih·yō·w·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem lō- mə·’as·tîm wə·lō- ḡə·‘al·tîm lə·ḵal·lō·ṯām lə·hā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tām kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Yet in spite of this when they are in the land of their enemies I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them for I am the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: E, demais disto também, estando eles na terra dos seus inimigos, não os rejeitarei nem me enfadarei deles, para consumi-los e invalidar a minha aliança com eles, porque eu sou o SENHOR seu Deus.

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי־ אֹתָם֩ מֵאֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֗ם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם לֵאלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tî lā·hem bə·rîṯ ri·šō·nîm ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî- ’ō·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim lih·yōṯ lā·hem lê·lō·hîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations that I might be their God I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Antes por amor deles me lembrarei da aliança com os seus antepassados, que tirei da terra do Egito perante os olhos dos gentios, para lhes ser por Deus. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְהַתּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕וֹ וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·ham·miš·pā·ṭîm wə·hat·tō·w·rōṯ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh bê·nōw ū·ḇên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·har sî·nay bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: These are the statutes ordinances and laws that the LORD established between Himself . . . and the Israelites . . . through Moses on Mount Sinai
verses.literalPt: Estes são os estatutos, e os juízos, e as leis que deu o SENHOR entre si e os filhos de Israel, no monte Sinai, pela mão de Moisés.
